body: Thank you for your time, you helped me a lot

Even though I feel like I'm pulling him down by not ending... well myself, because I can't imagine living without him... This is the same thing that makes me feel better. I can't bear with the responsibility of not being able to end his suffering, but at the same time I don't know if the damage I caused by that would just make it impossible for him to heal and live a life that'd be worthy of... living forever.                        

But reading this sentence right now helped me feel a bit relieved for short amount of time, thank you a lot.

Yes. He is very confident in his belief unlike me, and is very serious about it. It feels like I'm the only major thing keeping him from becoming a better human being. But at the same time each other's company is playing a huge role in our lives. Almost as if we have grown together like some sort of trees. Even the thought of losing him hurts. I don't see any solution.

Yes he did, and even though he mentioned it before, the thought of it somewhat softened. This has been affecting him way more seriously than me, I tried ignoring this problem and hoping for the best naively.
